mapper.select: SELECT status, cancel_requested_at FROM pipeline_execution WHERE id = #{executionId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cancel_requested_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS not_cancelling_count FROM pipeline_execution WHERE pipeline_id = #{pipelineId} AND status IN
mapper.update: UPDATE pipeline_execution SET cancel_requested_at = COALESCE(cancel_requested_at, #{now}), cancel_requested_by = COALESCE(cancel_requested_by, #{userId}) WHERE id = #{executionId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT cancel_requested_at FROM pipeline_execution WHERE id = #{executionId}

SELECT pipeline_id FROM pipeline_execution WHERE id = #{executionId}
SELECT executed_by FROM pipeline_execution WHERE id = #{executionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pipeline_step_execution (execution_id, step_id, step_name, status) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{stepId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{stepName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT step_id, started_at FROM pipeline_step_execution WHERE id = #{stepExecId}

SELECT pe.id, pe.pipeline_id, pe.status, pe.executed_by, pe.started_at, pe.completed_at, pe.created_at, u.name AS user_name, pe.triggered_by, pt.name AS trigger_name, pe.cancel_requested_at FROM pipeline_execution pe LEFT JOIN u ON pe.executed_by = u.id LEFT JOIN pipeline_trigger pt ON pe.trigger_id = pt.id WHERE pe.pipeline_id = #{pipelineId} ORDER BY pe.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pipeline_execution WHERE pipeline_id = #{pipelineId}

SELECT pe.id, pe.pipeline_id, pe.status, pe.executed_by, pe.started_at, pe.completed_at, pe.created_at, pe.error_message, p.name AS pipeline_name, u.name AS user_name, pe.cancel_requested_at, canceller.name AS canceller_name FROM pipeline_execution pe JOIN pipeline p ON pe.pipeline_id = p.id LEFT JOIN u ON pe.executed_by = u.id LEFT JOIN canceller ON pe.cancel_requested_by = canceller.id WHERE pe.id = #{executionId}

SELECT pse.id, pse.step_id, COALESCE(pse.step_name, ps.name) AS resolved_step_name, pse.status, pse.output_rows, pse.log, pse.error_message, pse.started_at, pse.completed_at FROM pipeline_step_execution pse LEFT JOIN pipeline_step ps ON pse.step_id = ps.id WHERE pse.execution_id = #{executionId} ORDER BY pse.id ASC
